Chapter 897: Chapter 3: The Struggle Between Immortals and Demons (Subscribe Please)_2

The contamination here refers to memory pollution, spiritual contamination.

In fact, Yun Zhenzi had prepared far more than just the method of resurrection such as the purple jade slip.

He also created numerous life pools and life stones; the moment his true body fell, his consciousness would resurrect upon the life pools and life stones.

However, the consciousness that resurrected in sync was all tainted with the contamination carried by the magical creatures. Only this purple jade slip, isolating the inside from the outside, blocking memories, severing cause and effect, and even unable to resurrect on its own, managing to barely avoid the pollution by relying on an external force to trigger it.

“Ancestor of the Demon Abyss?”

Lin Yuan thought to himself, with his realm’s perception, he had long sensed that twelfth-layer existence deep in the Demon Abyss, but he didn’t expect the other party to be so terrifying.

“The pollution of the demonic creatures probably poses no threat to me.”

Lin Yuan thought privately, the so-called pollution is not necessarily undefendable, but rather depends on whether one’s own spiritual will is strong enough.

Lin Yuan’s mental consciousness is obviously strong enough. Let alone the pollution of demonic creatures, even the contamination from the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss, Lin Yuan could easily withstand.

…

“Originally, I had planned to find a place to cultivate in seclusion, but now it seems, there is no need for that.”

After sorting through Yun Zhenzi’s memories, Lin Yuan was quickly pondering.

Yun Zhenzi, as a Jade Immortal, had many properties and cave dwellings in the various Immortal Cities of the thirty-three celestial regions.

The nearest ‘Cangwu’ Immortal City even has an A-grade fortification dwelling.

An A-grade fortification dwelling, being the top-tier dwelling in Cangwu Immortal City, is not only secure but also exhibits significant fluctuations of the laws, which greatly benefits law comprehension.

Now Lin Yuan, holding the Jade Immortal consciousness of Yun Zhenzi, is equivalent to Yun Zhenzi himself. He could take over that A-grade fortification dwelling whenever he wishes.

As for whether the A-grade fortification dwelling would be reclaimed after Yun Zhenzi’s fall?

In fact, every cave dwelling in the Immortal Cities belongs to the Immortal City; even Yun Zhenzi, the buyer, only had the right of ownership for ten billion years.

After ten billion years, the dwelling would be reclaimed.

As for Yun Zhenzi’s purchase of the A-grade dwelling, not even twenty million years had passed, far from the ten billion year reclamation period.

The major Immortal Cities of the thirty-three celestial regions are under the jurisdiction of the Ancestral Master, their authority is unquestionable, and there will not be a case of early reclamation of dwellings.

After all, beings capable of purchasing A-grade dwellings are at least top-tier Golden Immortals, and most of them are outright Jade Immortals. Reclaiming the dwellings of such powerful beings prematurely poses great risks.

Other Golden Immortals and Jade Immortals are watching; if you reclaim a certain top-tier Golden Immortal’s dwelling today, will my dwelling be reclaimed tomorrow?

“Cangwu Immortal City?”

Lin Yuan’s gaze looked distantly in a certain direction.

It was the location of Cangwu Immortal City, one of the fifteen great Immortal Cities in the Xuantian Immortal Domain, a place the original ‘Gao Wuyou’ could only dream of living.

Not only is Cangwu Immortal City safe, unlike being outside where one could encounter magical creatures at any time, but the cultivation environment is even more generous.

Even if it’s not a dwelling, just on the streets of Cangwu Immortal City, one would feel sufficiently rich fluctuations of the law.

Unfortunately, unless one has a fixed dwelling in Cangwu Immortal City, one would incur a certain fee for each day spent there.

One or two years might not matter, but as immortals, a single session of secluded cultivation could last thousands to tens of thousands of years, which makes Transcendance Tribulation Stage cultivators dare not reside in Cangwu Immortal City permanently.

And to purchase a dwelling? That’s an even more considerable expense, even the lowest D-grade dwelling is far more than what a Transcendance Tribulation Stage cultivator can afford.

Originally, Yun Zhenzi had a hard time purchasing the A-grade dwelling in Cangwu Immortal City.

Yun Zhenzi’s strength, even among Jade Immortals, was considered powerful. Had he not been besieged and killed by over a dozen magical creatures of the same layer, he would not have fallen.

Even so, in the resurrection methods left by Yun Zhenzi, he withstood the contamination from the magical creatures, a pity that he encountered an unreasonable existence like Lin Yuan, otherwise, he would have probably ‘resurrected’ successfully by now.

“First, let’s refine out the Primordial Spirit, then have the Primordial Spirit go to Cangwu Immortal City to see if it can take over that A-grade dwelling.”

Lin Yuan made up his mind, the benefits of an A-grade dwelling for comprehending the laws were deeply etched in Yun Zhenzi’s memory, otherwise, he would not have spent a large sum of money to purchase it.

And Lin Yuan’s time in the Immortal Realm is limited, so he naturally wants to choose the best cultivation environment, so that he can leave more time to prepare for the ultimate challenge.

…

Time passes by.

In the blink of an eye, more than half a month had gone by.

“Taiyin and Taiyang emerge.”

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, and two ethereal figures materialized from formlessness, slowly stepping out from within his body.

It was Lin Yuan’s Taiyin and Taiyang Primordial Spirit.

During this time, Lin Yuan forcibly transformed the Immortal Path foundation of his original body into a Martial Tao foundation, directly condensing two major Primordial Spirits.

Once the two Primordial Spirits were formed, things became much more convenient for Lin Yuan, and he wouldn’t have to take care of everything personally.

Although with Lin Yuan’s mental willpower, he could easily condense an incarnation, an incarnation is different from a Primordial Spirit Avatar; it is easily discerned by others.

“You take Yun Zhenzi’s Jade Immortal consciousness and head to Cangwu Immortal City.”

Lin Yuan looked at the Taiyang Divine Spirit and commanded.

The reason for sending the Taiyang Divine Spirit to Cangwu Immortal City was to be cautious.

After all, Yun Zhenzi has perished nearly ten million years ago, who knows if the cave mansion left behind still exists, and even if it does, whether there would be any unforeseen incidents when taking over?

Of course, the probability of such things happening is very small; the credibility of Immortal City is beyond doubt, and they face not only the Jade Immortal like Yun Zhenzi.

Always assuming the worst is never wrong.

If the Taiyang Divine Spirit went to Cangwu Immortal City and an extreme situation occurred, Lin Yuan would only lose a Primordial Spirit.

If everything goes smoothly, the Taiyang Divine Spirit would take over that Grade A cave mansion, and the significant fluctuations of the cave mansion’s rules would also be perceived by the true body.

Therefore…

Sending a Primordial Spirit to Cangwu Immortal City is the most cautious approach.

It’s nothing if it fails; but if it succeeds, a Grade A cave mansion that can accelerate cultivation will be obtained.

Swoosh.

Under Lin Yuan’s gaze, the Taiyang Divine Spirit quietly disappeared into the distance.

…

“Cangwu Immortal City is over there?”

In the high sky, Lin Yuan’s Taiyang Divine Spirit continuously traversed the void towards Cangwu Immortal City.

With Lin Yuan’s understanding and perception of the Space-Time Rule, what would take his true identity, ‘Gao Wuyou’, several years or even decades to reach, only took a few dozen breaths of time for the Cangwu Immortal Body to appear within Lin Yuan’s field of vision.

“Is that Cangwu Immortal City?” Lin Yuan stopped traversing the void, looking at the endlessly grand Immortal City from afar.

This Immortal City seemed like a vast world, with walls billions and trillions of miles high, filled with an ancient and mysterious aura that even a Jade Immortal would show sufficient awe when facing the Immortal City.

“It is said that each of the thirty-three Immortal Domains’ cities was established by the Ancestral Master. Out of pity for all beings, he connected each Immortal City with the Primordial Lands of the Immortal Realm. Hence, as long as one is in the Immortal City, they can feel the intense fluctuations of the laws.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

This is also why countless immortals yearn to live in the Immortal City, as the benefits for cultivation are truly immense.

“Let’s go in.”

Lin Yuan flew towards Cangwu Immortal City, quickly arriving outside the East Gate.

“Rules fluctuation…”

Lin Yuan smoothly entered Cangwu Immortal City and immediately felt a different set of rule fluctuations compared to the outside.

“These rule fluctuations are comparable to some of the cultivation sanctuaries’ secrets within the Main Universe.”

Some surprise flashed in Lin Yuan’s heart.

And this was only the outer city of Cangwu Immortal City.

If it was the inner city or even the Cave Mansion Area, the displayed fluctuations of a Grade A cave mansion would only become more significant.

“However, the entire Immortal City is enveloped in countless killing formations, which, once activated, not even Yun Zhenzi at his peak could withstand.”

Lin Yuan also sensed the omnipresent flow of Cangwu Immortal City’s infinite formations.

“Let’s first head to the cave mansion area of the Immortal City.”

Lin Yuan reined in his thoughts and didn’t dwell on it any longer.

No matter how numerous the killing formations within the Immortal City were, they posed no threat to him.

It was just a Primordial Spirit after all, not carrying any resources or treasures.
